options.name: TVS iQube
options.summary: Comfortable, easy city commuter per Autocar; little direct reliability or service data in sources

options.name: Ather 450
options.summary: Best handling, but least comfortable and stiff ride in 2022 test

options.name: Bajaj Chetak
options.summary: Comfortable but dated; almost no evidence on reliability or service

options.name: Ampere
options.summary: Vendor-claimed real range and service points; unverified

scores.rationale: Autocar ranks it a step above Chetak as a comfortable commuter
Only claimed range (140 km, 2022) is available
Claimed 146 km; Eco mode usable at low charge
Brake power cut and complaint volume
430 centres but 80,000 monthly complaints and 30-45 day waits (2024); fix plans unverified

recommendation.headline: TVS iQube, as a provisional pick on thin evidence
recommendation.summary: The sources give no direct reliability or service-network data for iQube, Ather or Chetak. iQube is leaned towards because it is the only major option with a positive commuter assessment and no documented service problems, while Ola has documented ones.

reasons.text: Autocar describes the iQube as a comfortable, easy-to-ride commuter, a step above the Chetak
Ola has documented service strain, which counts against it on your top priorities

tradeoffs.text: Aggressive regen takes getting used to; claimed range only

alternatives.when: You prioritise handling and can accept a stiff, cramped ride
You want a comfortable commuter and do not need modern features
Budget matters; its range and service figures are vendor claims

caveats: Autocar test is from 2022 in Mumbai
Absence of evidence on iQube service is not evidence of good service
nextSteps: Check Bengaluru service centre density and owner reviews for each brand
Test ride and ask dealers for real range at your route

contradictions.assessment: Ola announced a 1,000-centre plan; whether it was delivered is not in the sources

uncertainties.text: No source gives real-world range for iQube, Ather or Chetak; only claimed figures
No service-network data for TVS, Ather or Bajaj in Bengaluru
uncertainties.howToResolve: Check brand dealer locators and recent owner forums

uncertainties.text: Reviews are from 2022 and Ola reports from 2024
Ampere claims come only from its own page
